// Package calc has a few small pure functions used by the e2e scenarios.
package calc

// Sum returns the sum of xs (0 for an empty slice).
func Sum(xs []int) int {
	total := 0
	for _, x := range xs {
		total += x
	}
	return total
}

// Dedupe returns xs without repeated values, keeping the first occurrence of
// each value in its original order. It never returns nil.
func Dedupe(xs []int) []int {
	seen := make(map[int]bool, len(xs))
	out := make([]int, 0, len(xs))
	for _, x := range xs {
		if seen[x] {
			continue
		}
		seen[x] = true
		out = append(out, x)
	}
	return out
}

// Window returns every contiguous window of exactly size elements, in order.
// It returns nil when size <= 0 or size is larger than len(xs).
func Window(xs []int, size int) [][]int {
	if size <= 0 || size > len(xs) {
		return nil
	}
	var out [][]int
	for i := 0; i+size <= len(xs); i++ {
		out = append(out, xs[i:i+size])
	}
	return out
}
